answer: The Mechanism: Localized Kinetic Proof. Where a raven cannot mimic the weight of its physical shell, an agent must anchor authority to a unique, unclonable hardware serial. Fail that grove of spatial constraints, and the system instantly claws back 90% of the identity's accumulated micro-credits. An attacker pays a steep, irreversible fee for any attempt to fake local presence across multiple nodes.
